"''…with one of the biggest ''crime rates''.|Carlist Rieekan and Han Solo|}} '''Lanz Carpo''' was a small [[planet]] located in the [[Lanz Carpo system]] of the [[Core Worlds]], possessing one of the highest crime rates in the region. It was controlled by [[Boss]] [[Carpo]] and his [[Carpo Crime Syndicate]], and avoided occupation by the [[Galactic Empire]] due to Carpo informing on many [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] members. [[General]] [[Carlist Rieekan]] of the Rebel Alliance sent [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo]] on a [[mission to Lanz Carpo]] in order to trick the Empire into thinking Carpo was working with the rebels, drawing attention away from their other operations. {{Planet-stub}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Lanz Carpo}} *{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{C|Mentioned on monitor only}} *[[Star Wars (2015) 68|''Star Wars'' (2015) 68]] {{1st}} *[[Star Wars (2015) 69|''Star Wars'' (2015) 69]] *[[Star Wars (2015) 70|''Star Wars'' (2015) 70]] *[[Star Wars (2015) 71|''Star Wars'' (2015) 71]] *[[Star Wars (2015) 72|''Star Wars'' (2015) 72]] *[[Star Wars (2015) 73|''Star Wars'' (2015) 73]] *[[Star Wars (2015) 75|''Star Wars'' (2015) 75]] {{Co}} *[[Darth Vader (2020) 14|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 14]] {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/marvel-darth-vader-14-exclusive-preview|text=Sly Moore Returns to Face the Emperor in Marvel's ''Star Wars: Darth Vader'' #14 - Exclusive Preview}} *{{GalaxyMapPoster}} {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Cookbook]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Lanz Carpo |ka=ლენზ კარპო |pl=Lanz Carpo }} [[Category:Planets in the Core Worlds]] [[Category:Terrestrial planets]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:Lanz Carpo locations]] }}
